notes.title: v1.0.3 - Equipment and Lighting changes!
notes.notes:
Hello all! Several reviewers and streamers have had difficulty with the amount of light and the inability to use your flashlight along with other items, so this change aims to fix those issues.

1. Beams of moonlight have been added to several westward-facing rooms, illuminating sections of them more.
2. A directional ambient light now provides a slight amount of illumination throughout.
3. The Flashlight is no longer a "player item", it's now independent of other equipped items.
4. To counterbalance these changes, the flashlight beam is now narrower, leaving more of the periphery dark when other lights are not present.


A few other quality improvements from other feedback:

1. [Spoiler] ||Dead phone and charger will attempt to auto-combine when picked up||.
2. Item spawn point orientations/positions adjusted.
